rtlDecisions.why: Title anchors at reading start; now right:120.
DRAW SVG TRACE -> «ترسیم مسیر SVG»; SVG kept Latin as a technical token inside <bdi>; no uppercase/letterSpacing.

Pen starts top-right and runs leftwards (counter-clockwise) like Persian writing; svg flipped with scaleX(-1), rect is symmetric so only start/winding change. Pen-tip, dash length, flash, linecap, timing unchanged.
direction:rtl on the column: title bar, text lines and avatar row sit at the right edge, avatar then name bar to its left. Widths unchanged.
left->right anchor under the right-aligned title bar and drawn from x=UW to 0 so it grows right-to-left.

rasterTextHandling: No raster or image assets in this demo.
concerns: The registry (demo-index.ts / comps.txt) lists this comp as 40 frames and the upstream mp4 is only 40 frames, while the animation is designed for 140 frames (hold at 90-140). The registry value comes from a misparse of the '40f' in the header comment, so standard renders and the Persian video only cover the trace phase (frames 0-39). I did not touch registry/shared files. Beats 48-140 were verified with the harness --duration 140 flag (debug offset constant removed from source): flash, content fade-in, hand-off, underline growth and final rest were all clean, but there is no original render to compare past frame 39.
No exported DURATION constant exists in the original; none was added.
